plugins.name: storm
plugins.description: Multi-perspective deep research that writes Wikipedia-style, fully-cited articles. Unofficial native implementation of the Stanford STORM methodology — no Python, no extra API keys.

skills.name: discuss
skills.description: Host a Co-STORM roundtable on a topic — a moderated multi-expert discourse the user steers beat by beat, backed by a dynamic mind map, wrappable at any point into a cited report. Interactive, resumable.
headings: 2. Beats — the core loop, one beat per assistant turn
3. Report — on a trigger phrase ("generate report", "生成报告", "出报告", …)
skills.description_zh: 围绕指定主题主持 Co-STORM 圆桌讨论，由主持人组织多位专家交流，用户可逐步引导方向，并配合动态思维导图。支持交互和恢复讨论，也可随时整理为带引用的报告。

skills.name: research
skills.description: Run the STORM pipeline on a topic — multi-perspective grounded research that produces a Wikipedia-style, fully-cited article under storm/<topic>/. Heavy, long-running, resumable.
headings: 4. Outline (main thread — two steps, in this order)
skills.description_zh: 运行 STORM 多视角研究流程，依据来源生成百科式、完整标注引用的文章，保存至 storm/<topic>/。适用于耗时较长、需要恢复执行的主题研究。
